description: UNDERSTANDING — the agent-readiness leaderboard across the whole catalog. Rank providers by agent readiness, and filter to those that DO satisfy (has) or do NOT satisfy (missing) specific dimensions — e.g. has="mcp_server,protected_resource_metadata" is the OAuth-capable MCP cohort, missing="agent_card" is the addressable market for a fix. Returns agent score + band alongside the Kin Score. Priced per result — $0.005 per request plus $0.0002 per record returned (less past 100), capped at $0.50 a request, under pay-as-you-go; included in Understanding and Influence. Estimate first at /api/v1/prices/estimate. See apis://prices.

band.description: Restrict to one or more agent-readiness bands.

context.description: Optional: why you are asking. One sentence — the task you are trying to complete, or what you expect to get back. Never included in the answer and never used to rank; it is read only when a result turns out to be wrong, which is when knowing the intent is what makes the report actionable.

has.description: Comma-separated dimensions the provider MUST satisfy (ANDed), e.g. mcp_server,idempotency.

missing.description: Comma-separated dimensions the provider must NOT satisfy (ANDed) — the gap view.

sort.description: Ranked by agent readiness, highest first.

name: find_agent_readiness
